title: ADSP Planner Service — Data I/O Schema
description: Canonical data definitions for the planner-service. Defines all entities exchanged via REST API and stored in MongoDB. Referenced by business rules (applicableDataElements) and test cases (testData.dataElementRef).

PlanningSession.description: A persistent planning workspace scoped to a single tenant and user. Encapsulates the entire lifecycle of a user's engagement with the Planning Agent.

sessionId.description: Unique identifier for the planning session (UUID v4).

tenantId.description: ADSP tenant identifier. Sessions are strictly isolated per tenant.

userId.description: Keycloak user identifier (sub claim). Sessions are scoped to tenant+user.

title.description: User-provided or AI-generated short title for the planning session.

status.description: Lifecycle status of the planning session.

businessModelId.description: Reference to the associated BusinessModel document.

hypothesisIds.description: References to SolutionHypothesis documents generated in this session.

openQuestions.description: List of unresolved questions the Planning Agent has identified.

nextSteps.description: Recommended next actions as of the last session state update.

specialistProgress.description: Map of specialist service ID to progress status.

createdAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the session was created.

updatedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the last modification.

lastResumedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the most recent session resume, or null if never resumed.

BusinessModel.description: The structured representation of the user's business problem, incrementally constructed by the Planning Agent from conversation. This is the Planning Agent's primary reasoning artifact.

modelId.description: Unique identifier for this business model document.

tenantId.description: ADSP tenant identifier for data isolation.

concepts.description: Ordered collection of identified and classified business concepts.

assumptions.description: Assumptions the Planning Agent has made about the problem domain.

unknowns.description: Areas of uncertainty or missing information identified by the Planning Agent.

confidenceScore.description: Agent-assigned confidence score (0-100) reflecting how well the business problem is understood. A score of 70 or above triggers solution hypothesis generation.

matchedPatternId.description: ID of the matched BusinessPattern, or null if no pattern match above threshold.

version.description: Monotonically incrementing version number for optimistic concurrency.

BusinessConcept.description: A single classified business concept identified by the Planning Agent from conversation. Concepts are the atomic building blocks of the business model.

conceptId.description: Unique identifier for this concept within the business model.

name.description: Short, descriptive name for the concept.

description.description: Optional extended description of the concept.

sourceText.description: Excerpt from conversation that led the agent to identify this concept.

ConceptRelationship.description: A directed relationship between two business concepts in the business model.

relationshipType.description: Type of directed relationship from source concept to target concept.

description.description: Optional clarifying note about the relationship.

SolutionHypothesis.description: A proposed ADSP-based solution approach derived from the business model. Treated as tentative and subject to user refinement.

hypothesisId.description: Unique identifier for this solution hypothesis.

tenantId.description: ADSP tenant identifier for data isolation.

patternId.description: ID of the BusinessPattern that informed this hypothesis, or null.

status.description: Lifecycle status of the solution hypothesis.

adspServices.description: List of ADSP service IDs recommended in this hypothesis.

summary.description: Plain-language summary of the proposed solution for non-technical stakeholders.

reasoning.description: The Planning Agent's explanation of why these services were recommended and how they address the business model.

implementationOrder.description: Recommended order for implementing the proposed ADSP services.

version.description: Version number for optimistic concurrency control.

BusinessPattern.description: A reusable template capturing a known GoA business process pattern with ADSP service mappings and clarifying questions. Stored in the ADSP Configuration Service.

patternId.description: Unique identifier for the business pattern.

tenantId.description: If set, a tenant-specific pattern override; null for global platform patterns.

purpose.description: One-paragraph description of what business problem this pattern addresses.

domainLanguage.description: Common domain terms used in this pattern type (used for pattern matching confidence).

commonFeatures.description: Typical features present in applications of this pattern type.

strongSignals.description: High-confidence indicators that a conversation matches this pattern.

weakSignals.description: Low-confidence or potentially misleading indicators for this pattern.

adspServiceMappings.description: ADSP services recommended for this pattern with their role.

clarifyingQuestions.description: Questions the Planning Agent should ask to confirm or rule out this pattern.

assumptions.description: Default assumptions made when this pattern is applied.

isActive.description: Whether this pattern is available for matching. Inactive patterns are soft-deleted.

ServiceMapping.description: Maps an ADSP service to its role within a business pattern.

role.description: The function this service plays in the pattern (e.g., 'intake form', 'status notifications').

required.description: Whether this service is required or optional in the pattern.

ConversationMessage.description: A single message in the planning session conversation. Messages are append-only and constitute the raw conversation history.

tenantId.description: ADSP tenant identifier for data isolation.

role.description: Message originator: user input, AI assistant response, or system-generated instruction.

agentId.description: Identifier of the specialist agent if this message was generated by a specialist (null for planner or user messages).

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the message was created.

SpecialistAgentConfig.description: Configuration for a specialist agent instance within a tenant. Stored in ADSP Configuration Service.

agentId.description: Unique identifier for this specialist agent configuration.

serviceId.description: The ADSP service this specialist covers (e.g., 'form-service').

isEnabled.description: Whether this specialist agent is available in the tenant.

modelVersion.description: Pinned Anthropic model version for this specialist (e.g., 'claude-sonnet-4-5').

SessionListResponse.description: Paginated response for session list API endpoint.

total.description: Total number of sessions matching the filter criteria.

DomainEvent.description: RabbitMQ domain event published by the planner-service for session lifecycle changes.

eventId.description: Unique identifier for this domain event.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the event occurred.

LLMRequest.description: Request payload sent to Anthropic Claude API for agent inference.

max_tokens.description: Maximum number of tokens in the response.

system.description: System prompt injecting agent persona and context.

ErrorResponse.description: Standard error response shape for the planner-service REST API.
